BetaConvention: Project: wrap(psi-chi). The opposite expression in the request is not used to reinterpret recorded beta.
Observations: All ten queued decisions in the original controlled #126 native stream, plus all native states through the first full bend. Times fixed by the source events, not by an improved result.
OfflineVariants: C same correction biased onto current #117 request at each force evaluation

NumericalEventRules.Direction: eta=wrap(chi-path_heading); zero crossing brackets from native samples. This is tangent error, not a unique optimal recovery heading.
NumericalEventRules.LateralReversal: Sign reversal of derivative of recorded normal error; retain changes exceeding 0.01m on each side within 0.1s, report raw and tolerance sensitivity.
NumericalEventRules.PhysicalExcursion: Between successive eta zero crossings, report extrema; classify a resolved directional lobe only if peak abs eta exceeds1deg and duration exceeds0.1s. Countersteering alone is not a physical excursion.
NumericalEventRules.Recovery: Report first e=0 crossing and next same-direction eta=0 after each turning point, not a claim of permanent stable tracking.

NativeGate: A single isolated change may proceed only if the same-state A/B/C comparisons and continuous native event sequence separate the cause, C has no safety/peak-beta/speed-loss tradeoff across relevant first-bend events, and the validated model applies. Otherwise stop with an audit and one proposed discriminating measurement. Never choose by a prettier steering trace or alter physics/cost/horizon together.
